startups.name: Nubis Communications
startups.one_liner: High-density optical interconnects for AI clusters.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Focuses on the physical layer of optical I/O, enabling higher bandwidth density than traditional pluggable optics.

founders.name: Peter Koh
founders.note: Veteran in optical networking hardware.

startups.name: Swave Photonics
startups.one_liner: Fabless semiconductor company designing holographic chips based on proprietary diffractive photonics technology.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Genuine departure from traditional display/compute interfaces by utilizing diffractive photonics at the chip level to enable holographic projection, moving beyond standard CMOS pixel-based rendering.

founders.name: Mike Noonen
founders.note: Industry veteran in semiconductor leadership.

startups.name: Silicon Mobility
startups.one_liner: Full-stack semiconductor solutions for real-time control in automotive and mobility applications.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Focuses on domain-specific architectures for real-time control, moving away from general-purpose MCUs to specialized hardware for energy-efficient mobility.

founders.name: Bruno Paucard
founders.note: Experienced executive in semiconductor and automotive sectors.

startups.name: Minima Processor
startups.one_liner: Ultra-low power semiconductor IP using dynamic margining to minimize energy consumption in digital logic.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Architectural innovation in power management at the logic level; allows for dynamic voltage/frequency scaling beyond standard static guard-banding.

founders.name: Lauri Koskinen
founders.note: PhD in Electrical Engineering, University of Turku.

startups.name: Zero Point Cryogenics
startups.one_liner: Manufacturer of specialized cryogenic cooling systems for quantum computing infrastructure.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Provides essential cryogenic infrastructure required for superconducting quantum processors; while not a compute architecture itself, it is a critical enabling hardware layer for the physics substrate.

startups.name: Nord Quantique
startups.one_liner: Quantum computing startup focused on hardware-based quantum error correction.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Focuses on bosonic codes for quantum error correction, representing a genuine attempt to solve the fault-tolerance bottleneck at the physical hardware level rather than relying solely on software-based error mitigation.

startups.name: QpiAI
startups.one_liner: Full-stack quantum and AI startup developing superconducting quantum processors and foundry capabilities.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Attempts to vertically integrate QPU manufacturing with quantum-classical hybrid software stacks, moving beyond pure software-layer quantum companies.

startups.name: CAEPlus
startups.one_liner: Developer of active liquid cooling technology for high-performance AI data centers.
startups.architectural_differentiation_note: Addresses the thermal management bottleneck in high-density AI compute, which is a critical physical infrastructure requirement for modern AI clusters.
